wind_variables.wind_speed_10m: km/h, instantaneous value at normalized interval start

source_model_note: The cache provenance is preserved; this manifest does not relabel Open-Meteo Best Match or ERA5 without response metadata.
height_method: windpowerlib.wind_speed.hellman with source height 10m, default hub height 9m and editable exponent 0.14
density_method: dry-air audit value pressure(Pa)/(287.05*(temperature+273.15)); no density correction applied to the certified SD6 curve
time_semantics: wind is retained at normalized interval start; it is not shifted like preceding-hour radiation; power is integrated over the same explicit interval
boundary_policy: uses existing normalized weather boundary records; no cyclic shift, copied year-start row or zero fill
